newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land to manage planned comm'l centre.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land to manage planned comm'l centre.

text.p: Ayala Land Inc said on Friday it had been awarded the management contract for proposed commercial centre in Manila's Quezon City district.

The shopping centre will be situated within a 16-hectare property which will also house a depot for the EDSA Metro Rail Transit System, a 16.8 km rail link between northern and southern Manila. Construction of the rail transit system had just started.

The contract was awarded by the MRT Development Corp in which ALI has a 15.8 percent stake. MRT Development Corp will manage the commercial spaces in the mass railway transit stations lining EDSA, the city's main north-south thoroughfare/
